connector.name: Claude Octopus
connector.registryDescription: Spawn multiple specialized Claude Code agents as MCP servers, each independently configured.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package claude-octopus. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xiaolai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key (leave unset to inherit from parent process)

env.name: CLAUDE_MODEL
env.description: Model: sonnet, opus, haiku, or full ID

env.name: CLAUDE_PERMISSION_MODE
env.description: Permission mode: default, acceptEdits, bypassPermissions, plan

env.name: CLAUDE_ALLOWED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of available tools (e.g. Read,Grep,Glob for read-only)

env.name: CLAUDE_APPEND_PROMPT
env.description: Additional system prompt appended to the default

env.name: CLAUDE_FACTORY_ONLY
env.description: Set to true to expose only the factory wizard tool
